text:
nina: Quick thought after reading the RPM handshake notes  we should aim for a "minimal manifest" that encodes only what adapters absolutely need to route & authenticate. Keep secrets out unless private mode explicitly allows them.

cooper: Agree. Minimal = (tenant_hash, affinity_hint, secret_ref, version, resolve_mode). Everything else can be negotiated separately.

lee: We need strong versioning semantics. If we bump `manifest_version`, older adapters must fail fast with a clear error code so control plane can fallback to an older route. Suggest codes: `MANIFEST_OK`, `MANIFEST_UNSUPPORTED`, `MANIFEST_FORMAT_ERROR`.

nina: Good. Also propose explicit negotiation step: control plane sends `manifest_v` + `capabilities_allowed`; adapter responds with `capabilities_supported` and `resolve_intent`. That prevents accidental access to KMS in private installs.

dina: For private/on-prem: adapters should never receive host KMS URIs. Instead they get `local_secret_path` or a signed token from customer's KMS gateway. Document that as a hard policy.

cooper: On migration/eviction: include `migration_id` and `grace_window` in the manifest. When affinity shifts, control plane issues a migration manifest for `grace_window` seconds so caches can be warmed and in-flight requests finish.

ops-bot: test-check: manifest-versioning-tests queued (v1->v2 compatibility), migration-grace-sim enabled.

lee: Also add `resolve_mode` enum: `eager`, `lazy`, `deferred`. `eager` resolves at handshake, `lazy` resolves on first use, `deferred` means external flow (customer-provided). Each has different lat/loss profiles.

nina: We should codify error classes from resolution: `RESOLVE_TEMP` (retry), `RESOLVE_BAD_POLICY` (do not retry, escalate), `RESOLVE_AUTHZ` (checkbox to route to audit path). Keep these in manifest spec so routing logic is deterministic.

dina: Operationally, require an audit_nonce per manifest and a telemetry_token that's a hash separate from tenant id. That way adapters can emit traces without exposing tenant names.

cooper: Implementation note: control plane attests manifest with a short signature and `manifest_id` so adapters can request resolution telemetry for a given manifest_id. Useful for debugging.

lee: For backward compatibility, `manifest_v=1` will map `secret_ref` semantics to direct host-resolve. `manifest_v=2` introduces capability negotiation and migration fields. We'll need an adapter deprecation timetable.

nina: Action items: 1) cooper to draft compact manifest schema (v2) + sample payloads, 2) lee to list adapter-side error handlers and runtime fallback matrix, 3) dina to write private-deployment MUST NOT rules and KMS gateway token examples. I'll assemble into RFC draft.

ops-bot: CI: unit-handshake-tests passed on branch, integration-migration-sim queued.

cooper: One more thought  include a tiny `capability_hash` in the manifest to ensure runtime sees exactly what control plane intended. If it mismatches, adapter should abort and log `MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH`.

dina: Sounds good. I'll add migration staleness checks to the eval plan.

nina: Thanks team  planning to open the RFC tonight unless objections. Quick :thumbsup: if ok.

lee: :thumbsup:

cooper: +1

ops-bot: deploy-note: manifest-rfc-draft PR created (link: https://git.internal/rfcs/manifest-v2)
